7.3.9 Interfacing with Default Error Tracer and Diagnostic Event
Manager CDD shall report errors using Det, Dem as described in the document [19] Description of the AUTOSAR standard errors. CDD shall use standard APIs of the Det & Dem modules. CDD shall react as any BSW modules. Error ID shall be defined locally in the CDD module. CDD is responsible for initiating an internal recovery.
